name: host_fact
description: Return one compiled registry field for a NAMED machine. Use only when the question names a host and asks what it is or has: role, cpu, gpu, ram, network address or status.

host.description: hostname such as frieren, eisen, delphi

name: notes_search
description: Search the decision-notes store: experiments, proposals, open work and studies. Use for 'which proposals exist about X' or 'open work on X'. Never for documentation files.

name: skills_tagged
description: List the skills carrying a tag. Use when the question asks which skills or procedures cover a topic.

tag.description: tag such as nix, sops, agent
